description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to product management, including creation, update, and response representations.

classes.name: CreateProductDto
classes.description: DTO used when creating a new product, containing 'Name' and 'Price' with validation attributes.

classes.name: UpdateProductDto
classes.description: DTO used when updating an existing product, containing 'Name' and 'Price' with validation attributes.

classes.name: ProductResponseDto
classes.description: DTO used for API responses to represent product details, including 'Id', 'Name', and 'Price'.
